record.text: 亡语：为敌方英雄恢复#5点生命值。
record.text_en: Deathrattle: Restore #5 Health to the enemy hero.

record.text_en: Deathrattle: Add an 'Arcane Missiles' spell to_your hand.

record.text_en: Battlecry: Add two 1/1 Pirates to your hand.

record.text: 战吼：为所有友方角色恢复#2点生命值。
record.text_en: Battlecry: Restore #2 Health to all friendly characters.

record.text: 战吼：你的下一张武器牌的法力值消耗减少（1）点。
record.text_en: [x]Battlecry: The next weapon you play costs (1) less.

record.name: 奥术飞弹
record.text: 造成$3点伤害，随机分配到所有敌人身上。
record.text_en: Deal $3 damage randomly split among all enemies.

face.name: 间谍女郎
face.text: 潜行
face.flavorText: 外域的间谍必须和环境融为一体。于是她们有了亮粉色的套装和翠绿翠绿的头发。多诡异的环境。

face.name: Spymistress
face.text: Stealth
face.flavorText: Spies in Outland must blend into the environment. That means hot-pink gear and bright green hair. It’s a weird place.

face.name: 沼泽水蛭
face.text: 吸血
face.flavorText: 除去四颗牙，都是高蛋白。

face.name: Swamp Leech
face.text: Lifesteal
face.flavorText: A face only a druid could love.

face.name: 正义保护者
face.text: 嘲讽 圣盾
face.flavorText: 本来想起名叫烈日保护者，但这里实在是太冷了。

face.name: Righteous Protector
face.text: Taunt Divine Shield
face.flavorText: Original name was Tubular Protector, but this seems more bodacious.

face.name: 死鳞骑士
face.text: 吸血
face.flavorText: “死鱼翻身”的杰出代表。

face.name: Deadscale Knight
face.text: Lifesteal
face.flavorText: His favorite spell is Chum Explosion.

face.name: 鱼人木乃伊
face.text: 复生
face.flavorText: 与其他木乃伊不同，人们把他和米饭、黄瓜条卷在了一起，还刷了一点酱油。

face.name: Murmy
face.text: Reborn
face.flavorText: Unlike other mummies, they rolled him up with rice, sliced cucumbers, and soy sauce on the side.

face.name: 地精炸弹
face.text: 亡语：对敌方英雄造成2点伤害。
face.flavorText: 这些婴儿潮时期出产的小家伙们是导致人口爆炸的一个重要原因。

face.name: Goblin Bomb
face.text: Deathrattle: Deal 2 damage to the enemy hero.
face.flavorText: They're Dr. Boom's babies. His baby boomers.

face.name: 肉用僵尸
face.text: 亡语：为敌方英雄恢复 5点生命值。
face.flavorText: 僵尸。好吃的僵尸。

face.name: Zombie Chow
face.text: Deathrattle: Restore 5 Health to the enemy hero.
face.flavorText: Zombie. It's what's for dinner.

face.name: 空气吉他手
face.text: 战吼：使你的武器获得+1耐久度。
face.flavorText: 举轻若重，声如微风。

face.name: Air Guitarist
face.text: Battlecry: Give your weapon +1 Durability.
face.flavorText: Nailing that solo was a breeze.

face.name: 紫罗兰魔翼鸦
face.text: 亡语：将一张“奥术飞弹”法术牌置入你的 手牌。
face.flavorText: 一鸟在手，抵得三弹在坟。

face.name: Violet Spellwing
face.text: Deathrattle: Add an 'Arcane Missiles' spell to your hand.
face.flavorText: A bird in the hand is worth three missiles in the grave.

face.name: 血帆飞贼
face.text: 战吼：将两张1/1的海盗牌置入你的手牌。
face.flavorText: 想飞上天，和海盗肩并肩。

face.name: Bloodsail Flybooter
face.text: Battlecry: Add two 1/1 Pirates to your hand.
face.flavorText: They’re pretty fly for some pirate guys.

face.name: 药水商人
face.text: 战吼：为所有友方角色恢复 2点生命值。
face.flavorText: 每人只能恢复2点，因为她只能抱住这么多。

face.name: Potion Vendor
face.text: Battlecry: Restore 2 Health to all friendly characters.
face.flavorText: Everyone gets two because that’s all she can hold.

face.name: 血帆桨手
face.text: 战吼：你的下一张武器牌的法力值消耗减少（1）点。
face.flavorText: 海盗打劫其实也算“打折”。

face.name: Bloodsail Deckhand
face.text: Battlecry: The next weapon you play costs (1) less.
face.flavorText: Piracy is technically a discount.

face.name: 奥术飞弹
face.text: 造成 3点伤害，随机分配到所有敌人身上。
face.flavorText: 既然你想要做一个超级厉害的法师，就必须得把奥术飞弹控制得好一些。

face.name: Arcane Missiles
face.text: Deal 3 damage randomly split among all enemies.
face.flavorText: You'd think you'd be able to control your missiles a little better since you're a powerful mage and all.
